# BoomerangHR

BoomerangHR is a Human Resources Services company. BoomerangHR is an affordable ai-powered offboarding and alumni management platform that automates workflows to turn departing talent into an active network of rehires, referrals, and sales leads. BoomerangHR employs 46 people (+142.1% YoY, +27 people), founded in 2023. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across Canada, United States, India, and South Africa.

## About

Hundreds of companies rely on BoomerangHR, the AI-powered platform that streamlines the complexities of offboarding and turns former employees into an active network of rehires, referrals, and sales leads. Founded by industry experts who are advised by leading CHROs, BoomerangHR is backed by Kalos Ventures and Album Ventures.
